name: Khadim India Ltd
title: Khadim India Ltd - 540775 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to INR83.6 cr (from 93.8 cr) with PAT margin 0.9%; management guides FY27 revenue ~INR400 cr at 14% EBITDA while inventory was cut ~40% and creditors slashed, signalling demand-led weakness rather than supply-side discipline.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue down 11% YoY
triggers.quote: revenue from operations stood at INR83.6 crores as against INR93.8 crores in the corresponding quarter last year, reflecting a decline
triggers.highlight: revenue from operations stood at INR83.6 crores

triggers.label: Raw material up 20-25% since Feb
triggers.quote: The raw material prices are increased around 20% to 25% compared to -- in the month of February to now
triggers.highlight: raw material prices are increased around 20% to 25%

triggers.label: FY27 revenue ~INR400 cr, 14% EBITDA
triggers.quote: we are targeting a turnover of around INR400 crores and an EBITDA margin of 14% at present
triggers.highlight: targeting a turnover of around INR400 crores

guidance.quote: we are targeting a turnover of around INR400 crores and an EBITDA margin of 14% at present
we will remain steady at the EBITDA level of 14%
I think we can expect another 50-basis point improvement in gross margin

red_flags.label: Creditors cut to fund working capital
red_flags.quote: we deliberately reduced the purchase and paid our creditors so that the creditors balance has also come down

red_flags.label: Cash and equity sharply lower post demerger
Discounting of sub-INR500 products; price cuts
red_flags.quote: we have taken some price cut in our product s less than INR500

evasions.quote: we'll keep the athleisure to the extent it is required, but we will not go far-fetched in athleisure
we cannot, I mean, give a comment on the gross margin because it depends on the volatility of the raw material price
